title: The airport landscape, then and now
subtitle: Historical map evidence and the September 2026 building inventory
idea: Show the transformation of the airport area without transplanting a modern skyline into history.
limit: Modern solids use approximate HKPD base/top elevations; missing or invalid records are omitted explicitly. Flat historical maps are not a 1993 solid city. No terrain surface is shown; the available DTM derives from 2014–2015 photographs.
caption: The right panel shows current-source building geometry, including development in the former airport area. The old airport is not depicted as operational in 2026. Cameras match horizontally; source epochs and vertical meanings remain separate.
